title: UTMC Common Primitives
description: Shared primitive types referenced by every domain schema.

CommandResponseStatus.description:
Outcome of a command execution.

Every value except ``PENDING`` is terminal. Consumers SHOULD test for
"not pending" rather than enumerating the terminal values, so that a
future profile adding one does not strand them.

Coordinates.description: A WGS84 geographic coordinate pair (longitude, latitude).

DateTypeDefinition.description:
Maps a specific calendar date to a day type category.

Used to classify special dates (e.g. 2025-04-18 as Easter Bank Holiday)
so that profiles and schedules can apply the correct day type.

dayTypeId.description: Reference to the day type this date is classified as.

abnormal.description: Whether this date is an abnormal (non-standard) day.

reason.description: Reason for the abnormal classification, e.g. 'Easter Bank Holiday'.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.

DayTypeDefinition.description:
Day type classification used for scheduling.

Predefined day types 1-7 cover Monday to Sunday. Custom day types
(8-100) can be added for special categories such as Bank Holidays
or Race Days.

preDefined.description: Whether this is a predefined day type (1-7 for Monday to Sunday).

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.

GeoJsonLineString.description:
A GeoJSON LineString geometry (RFC 7946).

An ordered sequence of two or more positions forming a polyline.
Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] per GeoJSON specification.

coordinates.description: Ordered [longitude, latitude] pairs forming a polyline.

GeoJsonPoint.description:
A GeoJSON Point geometry (RFC 7946).

Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] per GeoJSON specification.

Point.description: A geographic point: a coordinate plus optional altitude.

altitudeMeters.description: Altitude in metres above mean sea level. Optional. Bounds [-1000, 5000] inherited from utmc_location-v1.0.xsd AltitudeType.

Quality.description: Quality statement attached to a UTMC data object or measurement.

sourceName.description: Name of the data source (e.g. 'SCOOT', 'MIDAS'). Required: a quality statement naming no source cannot be interpreted.

sourceType.description: Free-text description of the source kind.

participantId.description: Identifier of the UTMC participant system that owns this quality statement.
participantId.title: ParticipantId

lastUpdated.description: When this quality statement was last updated.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.

SubsystemDefinition.description:
Catalogue entry for a UTMC subsystem type.

Follows the standard TypeDefinitionStructure pattern: TypeId +
TypeDescription + TypeNotes + SpecificationLink + Extensions.

specificationLink.description: URL to an external specification document for this subsystem type.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.
